messages:
anna: Quick triage — ACME asked for: 7y audit retention, BYOK keystore onboarding, and a 2hr audit-export SLA. Can we surface launch gates this sprint?

dario: short answer: not all of that is realistic this sprint. 7y retention + fast export requires archive + index work. BYOK handshake adds security ops and legal. we need to scope MVP.

mira: +1 to scope down. propose: (1) 90d retention hot search + cold archive for >90d (exportable), (2) BYOK handshake for keys but limited to metadata-only initially (no escrow), (3) audit-export SLA = best-effort for MVP, target 24h.

eli: ops note: cold archive export pipeline will need an S3-compatible staging with lifecycle. ETA for a minimal pipeline ~3 sprints if we allocate infra work. can we trade export SLA for a documented runbook?

sam: from SRE perspective, SLA needs an SLI. suggestion: define "export-availability" and "export-complete-within-window" metrics. we can set alerting if >10% of exports exceed window.

anna: high-level launch criteria idea (draft):
- BYOK handshake proto validated with one pilot customer
- audit export runbook documented and tested end-to-end (manual)
- retention tiering implemented (hot 90d + cold immutable store)
- SLIs defined and dashboards live
If we hit these, we call it "pilot-ready" not GA. Thoughts?

dario: sounds reasonable. for BYOK pilot we need: key rotation policy, KMS ACL mapping, and the handshake UX (tenant admin modal + server-side verification). dev estimate: ~2 devs x 4 weeks for core integration + 1 infra week for vault provisioning.

mira: security asks: require customer proof-of-possession flow and signed key metadata. we should include a minimal threat model in the PRD. also: legal wants opt-in legal-hold exemptions flagged at export time.

anna: can we capture minimal threats here? Mira, can you drop 3 bullet threat model items in the thread?

mira: sure —
- risk: customer key exfiltration during onboarding -> mitigation: ephemeral key checks + audit of transfer channel
- risk: export tampering -> mitigation: signed manifests + integrity checksums
- risk: unauthorized export requests -> mitigation: tenant-scoped ACL + human approval for >30d exports

eli: runbook TODOs I see: export preflight (quota + ACL), staging bucket lifecycle, integrity verification, legal-hold check, notify customer. I'll sketch an ops playbook this week.

sam: SLI proposal snippet:
```
export_success_rate = exports_completed_within_24h / exports_requested
export_latency_P95 = 95th_percentile(export_completion_time)
```
We can start with these and tune windows later.

anna: prioritization ask: do we (A) push to backlog and do a 2-sprint spike to prove pipeline, or (B) include in next sprint with tradeoffs (limit to 90d retention + manual exports only)? vote please.

dario: B with caveat: scope retention to 90d hot + manual cold exports. run spike for archive automation concurrently.

mira: A — I want the spike to validate security model before onboarding pilots.

eli: B but with a hard guardrail: no production customer BYOK until spike completes. pilot can use staging keys.

anna: ok consensus leaning B for product velocity, with security guardrail from Eli and a mandatory spike output before any live BYOK onboarding. I'll update the PRD and add acceptance criteria.

keystore-bot: deploy-check: keystore-staging provisioned in dev (ok). Next: request a test key exchange via /internal/keystore/test to validate handshake.

anna: thanks — I'll assign follow-ups, add a short checklist to the PRD, and set a mid-sprint sync.
